source: design choice, not empirical; validate locally
before_cell_rule: From the reported first-change cell, take one adjacent grid step toward unchanged weather on either axis; choose the predecessor farthest from unchanged weather in normalized grid-step distance, with temperature-axis precedence for a tie.
near_tie_rule: A flip is a near-tie when the top-two distinct-cycle weighted-score gap is at most near_tie_gap in either the before or after cell.
